Squirrely

Cross the highway. Fill all four tree hollows. Every car is a driver with a personality — Red hunts, Yellow panics, Blue swerves for you, Green rages in jams, Purple doesn't see you, White is steady.

Arrows/WASD hop · Space dash (2 rows) · hold Shift crouch · T taunt · E drop smoke · V 1st‑Squirrel view · Esc pause
Hopping costs stamina — rest (or crouch) to get it back, or eat the acorns lying on the road. Smoke bombs lie among them: carry one and drop it (E) to light a plume that stops traffic. Lanes run at different speeds and every driver has an opinion about that. Watch out for motorcycles: faster, and they dodge inside their lane. Ice in winter: nobody stops in time.
Touch: swipe to hop, tap to taunt, double‑tap to dash, long‑press to drop, two‑finger hold to crouch.
